sharedContract.definition: A delivery contract states what the route accepts, how it adapts the creative treatment, exactly what it must deliver, and what evidence makes that delivery complete. It is a product specification, not a legal agreement.
defaults: Single-image work: two independently checked creative options per selected format.
Multi-image sets: two complete options unless a contract explicitly proposes concept selection before production.
Long documents, full catalogues and production print: two outlines/concepts, then one selected complete production deliverable is proposed. CX policy documents use one factual version.
An option count, slot count, target profile or native file type cannot be changed silently to make a job appear complete.
requiredFields: brandId + source research revision + exact SKU/variant or explicit brand-only mode
source snapshot IDs and hashes; permitted claim/quote/price references
option count + required slots + order/dependencies + requested languages/regions
canvas or physical size; reading context; native fields; output formats; file limits
locked copy/qualifiers; rights/approval requirements; external prerequisites
budget/reservation policy; idempotency key; parent/child IDs; selected output hashes
handoff: Strategist: records the audience task, channel context, supported promise, reason-to-believe and desired action.
Creative director: selects the storytelling premise and explains what changes for this placement; distinct concepts remain within the same factual brief.
Copywriter + art director: agree embedded versus native text, copy capacity, hierarchy, scene and safe space before rendering.
Production: builds every contracted image/native file; durable child records allow resuming missing work without discarding completed outputs.
Review: inspects actual rendered files at intended viewing size and reviews the whole set; records evidence, rationale and observed problems separately.
Delivery: freezes selected versions, native copy, sources, checks and exact file hashes in a manifest. External publishing/printing acceptance is recorded separately.
gates: Input gate: missing mandatory sources/template/eligibility stops the relevant route with a specific reason before paid generation.
Plan gate: every required slot and native field has a purpose, source and copy/layout budget.
Artifact gate: two promised options means two passing options; every required child and native export must exist and pass applicable checks.
Set gate: order, continuity, claims, variants and dependencies checked across the entire option. A saved image or passing child cannot make an incomplete project Ready.
Handoff gate: filenames, actual dimensions/bytes/hashes, links, CDN verification and selected source versions agree; no stale review reused after edits.
External acceptance: only actual host/client/publisher/operator evidence can establish site, send, publishing or physical-production acceptance. Preview-only outputs remain labelled as such.
architecture: One shared contract registry and renderer/export adapters for both brands; separately scoped brand and SKU evidence.
Validate the same pinned profile at catalogue, brief, dispatch, preview and export. Free-form labels must not create hidden size differences.
Persist parent/set and child states; bounded queue and provider concurrency, cancellation, restart recovery and per-child budgets. Do not make the entire pack one giant prompt/upload.
Known retryable failures follow bounded, recorded recovery. An ambiguous paid response is reconciled before a resend; charges remain unknown, not zero.
Immutable versions and independently reviewable child results; completed work is reused only when pinned inputs, source hashes and validators match.
Delivery adapters for raster, HTML/native payload, DOCX/PPTX/PDF and vendor output. A raster export cannot impersonate a missing native adapter.
Verified non-personal media links/hashes enter the Git CDN inventory; private briefs, responses, personal records and credentials do not. Separate private metadata backup remains necessary.
liveAcceptance: At least ten varied new live generation scenarios for each affected route; subprofiles need explicit coverage, not ten copies of the same brief.
Balance Duroflex and Sleepyhead where the route is applicable, using each brand’s own saved products, sources and rules.
Vary SKU/variant, image source type, aspect ratio, language, copy length, entry point and multi-item count.
Exercise refresh/back/forward, brand switching, concurrent projects, cancellation, partial child failure, interrupted review, stale version selection and resume.
For source-dependent routes include valid evidence, missing mandatory evidence and conflicting/expired data; invalid cases must stop before a paid call.

Report live generation, preflight rejection, unit tests, saved replays, browser checks and external acceptance separately. Rejections and offline simulations cannot be counted as successful live generation scenarios.

Pass means complete required options/sets, native exports, visual checks, navigation and cost records. Retain every failure and retry in the denominator; no promise that external outages or generative errors can never recur.

pdpProposedSlots.purpose: Show appropriate scale and believable use.
pdpProposedSlots.evidence: Product identity and permitted use; scene remains a creative choice.

pdpProposedSlots.title: Primary benefit
pdpProposedSlots.purpose: Communicate the strongest supported reason to choose.

pdpProposedSlots.title: Second purchase reason
pdpProposedSlots.evidence: Separate factual support; no filler claim.

pdpProposedSlots.title: Technology / construction
pdpProposedSlots.purpose: Explain a verified mechanism or construction fact.
pdpProposedSlots.evidence: Exact-SKU technology evidence; cutaway only if documented.

pdpProposedSlots.title: Materials / finish
pdpProposedSlots.purpose: Describe what the customer will receive.

pdpProposedSlots.title: Surface / product detail
pdpProposedSlots.purpose: Show a useful close-up without changing branding or texture.

pdpProposedSlots.title: Dimensions
pdpProposedSlots.purpose: Explain fit using accurate labels and units.
pdpProposedSlots.evidence: Chosen variant dimensions; never inferred from pixels.

pdpProposedSlots.purpose: Help select the right variant or product.
pdpProposedSlots.evidence: Approved like-for-like matrix; substitute only after scope review.

pdpProposedSlots.evidence: Approved applicable policy; no invented warranty or promise.

pdpSlotCaveat: Proposed sequence for review, not the confirmed client template. A missing factual source blocks that slot or requires an explicitly approved replacement; do not invent a claim to reach twelve.

contracts.title: Full 12-image PDP pack
contracts.treatment: Answer the purchase questions in a deliberate sequence: identity, benefit, evidence, fit and ownership. Give each frame one job. Use a consistent product and visual system across the set; dimension and specification cards need a different reading layout from lifestyle photography.
inputs: Exact saved SKU and variant; source-backed features, dimensions, materials and usage facts.
Client’s 12-slot template, intended product-page component, display widths and image specifications.
Verified comparison, care and warranty information only for slots that require it.
outputs: Two complete creative options: 12 ordered images each, 24 required images total. No partial set presented as a complete option.
Per-slot filenames, alt text, copy, purpose, source references and reading context; a contact sheet for each option.
JPG/PNG/WebP as the agreed host profile permits; exact canvas and compression pinned before rendering. ZIP plus set manifest and reviews.
acceptanceChecks: All 12 distinct, required slots pass individually and as a set; ordering and product/variant consistency checked.
Measurement lines and labels match evidence; technology markings remain correct; small-preview copy and qualifiers are readable.
A failed slot holds its option incomplete; a failed option holds the requested pair incomplete.
contracts.implementationGap: Existing image generation and review are building blocks. Durable 12-slot orchestration, resume and whole-pack acceptance remain to be completed; current small-batch caps must not simply be removed.
contracts.reviewDecision: Review the proposed 12-slot sequence below. Confirm the client template and PDP viewing sizes before fixing the export profile.

scopeItems.asset: Alt text for every product image

contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Technology, layers & construction
contracts.treatment: Explain one mechanism visually. Use a labelled technical illustration only when exact-SKU evidence supports the depicted construction; separate scientific explanation from a lifestyle benefit scene.
inputs: Official exact-SKU layer/construction diagrams or supplied approved CGI.
Verified layer names, order, material descriptions and permissible benefits.
outputs: Two treatments for each requested technical card, with a clean illustration and separate annotation data where the source allows.
Source-bound labels and accessible description; editable annotation layout proposed, not a claim of editable 3D geometry.
acceptanceChecks: No invented layer counts, materials, internal structure or efficacy.
Labels point to the right part and remain readable at intended size.
contracts.implementationGap: Raster generation is available; a source-bound technical illustration/annotation delivery route is not established as complete.
contracts.reviewDecision: Choose annotated stills only, or require editable diagrams too. Missing internal evidence blocks cutaways rather than guessing.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Proof, certifications & comparison cards
contracts.treatment: Lead with the specific evidence, retain its limitations, and make a fair comparison on like-for-like attributes. Avoid decorative badges that imply nonexistent certification.
inputs: Approved claims, certification files, expert permissions and qualifying text.
Dated comparison table with matched product variants and measurement units.
outputs: Two treatments for each requested card plus a structured claim/evidence table.
Footnotes and sources remain attached to the image and accompanying copy; editable comparison table proposed.
acceptanceChecks: Every claim, quote and comparison cell has a source; no stronger claim than the evidence.
Disclaimers and comparison headings readable; expiry and exclusions checked.
contracts.implementationGap: General claim review exists; full comparison-table authoring, expiry checks and editable exports need dedicated contracts and implementation.
contracts.reviewDecision: Confirm permitted comparison competitors and claim owner; do not use invented comparison data in a launch test.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Marketplace & website listing sets
contracts.treatment: The main image establishes the exact item being sold; secondary images answer purchase questions. Do not carry promotional typography or room props into a main-image slot that prohibits them.
inputs: Marketplace, country, category, SKU/variant and selected listing template.
Required gallery count/order, main-image rules and source product photos.
outputs: Two complete sets of N images; N is fixed by the selected listing contract, not assumed to be 12.
Main image, ordered secondary gallery, filenames, alt/metadata where supported, source and version manifest.
acceptanceChecks: Per-slot background, framing, crop, file and resolution requirements checked against the selected marketplace profile.
No included-accessory ambiguity, watermark, unverified variant or misleading scale.
contracts.implementationGap: Existing product-image generation does not establish a complete marketplace listing set or marketplace acceptance.
contracts.reviewDecision: Choose the first marketplaces and categories; provide/export their current seller templates and gallery counts.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Standard A+ content
contracts.treatment: Build a persuasive product page from connected modules: context, benefit, proof and use. Put longer text in native module fields; give image panels concise messages and adequate reading space.
inputs: Marketplace/account and standard A+ module template with IDs, dimensions and field limits.
Brand story and verified SKU features; selected module count/order and destination identifiers.
outputs: Two complete module directions; each contains every selected image panel and native text field.
Module JSON/CSV, ordered preview, alt text and permitted metadata, with final asset URLs/hashes.
acceptanceChecks: Every required module field and image exists; native text and embedded copy do not contradict each other.
Actual small-width module preview passes readability and product fidelity; all modules form one coherent option.
contracts.implementationGap: Generic module rendering and copy-fit repair exist. Reliable passing small-preview artwork and complete template-bound packaging remain open.
contracts.reviewDecision: Agree the first standard module set and whether both complete directions are needed, or two concepts then one full build.

scopeItems.asset: A+ alt text and search-keyword metadata

contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Marketplace comparison modules
contracts.treatment: Help shoppers select a suitable product using structured, sourced differences. Prefer native comparison fields when the selected template supports them.
inputs: Eligible comparison module, permitted SKUs/ASINs and source-backed attribute matrix.
Approved row labels, units, variant definitions and destination links.
outputs: One validated data matrix; two visual treatments if the template uses imagery.
Native module field package, referenced images and target-preview evidence.
acceptanceChecks: Each cell resolves to the right SKU and current saved evidence; units and qualifiers consistent.
No fabricated ranking, prices, ratings or unsupported competitor inclusion.
contracts.implementationGap: Comparison is listed in scope; native marketplace mapping and full table validation are not established.
contracts.reviewDecision: Confirm within-brand range comparison versus competitive comparison and the permitted product count.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Premium A+ static modules
contracts.treatment: Use the selected Premium template’s richer layout intentionally, with coordinated image panels, native copy and interactions. A larger standard A+ image does not satisfy this contract.
inputs: Confirmed account eligibility and chosen Premium module definitions.
Required static panels, interaction fields, exact dimensions and approved copy; any video dependency declared separately.
outputs: Two complete static directions for the agreed Premium module set, plus all native fields and preview mapping.
Manifest explicitly lists unsupported video/interactive dependencies; no substitution disguised as completion.
acceptanceChecks: Eligibility and every selected module requirement recorded; responsive template previews checked.
Static coverage cannot be labelled a complete Premium page when the brief also requires unbuilt interactions or video.
contracts.implementationGap: Premium-specific authoring, eligibility/profile mapping and delivery are missing; generic raster modules are insufficient.
contracts.reviewDecision: Which Premium modules are in the first release? Review static-only scope and exact module count.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Campaign master key visuals
contracts.treatment: Strategist defines the audience problem, supported promise and action. Creative director proposes continuity and a contrasting storytelling idea; the master is a concept system, not a universal crop for all placements.
inputs: Campaign objective, audience, key message, exact SKU or approved brand-only brief.
Same-brand sources and intended channel list.
outputs: Two master concepts with message, copy hierarchy, scene/layout plan and rationale.
Two master images at the agreed primary placement plus adaptation instructions; other placements generated through their own contracts.
acceptanceChecks: Different concepts retain the same factual promise; contrast changes the premise and meaningful visual choices.
Rationale distinguishes sourced brand rules from creative judgments.
contracts.implementationGap: Shared creative planning exists; a reusable, versioned master-to-placement handoff requires explicit implementation and acceptance.
contracts.reviewDecision: Approve two master concepts as the default starting point; placement versions remain additional deliverables.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Meta feed: square, portrait & landscape
contracts.treatment: Deliver a complete idea during a feed scroll: immediate product/message hierarchy, restrained embedded text, supporting details in the caption. Recompose the scene and negative space for each ratio.
inputs: Organic versus paid destination, chosen ratios, audience/action and native copy requirements.
Exact SKU and approved claims, terms and destination URL.
outputs: Two options per selected ratio. Client-scope profiles: 1080×1080 square, 1080×1350 portrait and 1200×628 landscape.
Separate caption or paid primary text/headline/CTA fields, alt text and image package. These are requested profiles, not universal platform limits.
acceptanceChecks: Catalogue, brief, rendered image, preview and export agree on dimensions.
Small feed preview readable; product, logo and required qualifiers survive real placement crops.
contracts.implementationGap: Square route exists and portrait routing is connected; complete catalogue coverage and repeated rendered acceptance remain separate.
contracts.reviewDecision: Confirm default square + portrait; make landscape an explicit selection rather than silently generating every ratio.

scopeItems.asset: Meta paid image + accompanying ad copy

contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Instagram Stories & static interaction frames
contracts.treatment: One fast message per full-screen vertical frame. Compose for vertical attention and real interface overlays. Put an intended sticker/action area in the layout; do not draw a fake working poll or countdown into artwork.
inputs: Organic versus paid Story, 1080×1920 client profile and current placement safe areas.
Frame purpose: product, offer, employee share, poll or countdown; supplied link/date/options where relevant.
outputs: Two 9:16 image options per requested frame plus caption/action and sticker-placement instructions.
Native poll choices, countdown timestamp/timezone or link fields as applicable, separate from the raster.
acceptanceChecks: Headline, logo and product clear of interface/sticker areas in the target preview.
Offer expiry/timezone and interaction fields valid; no claim that exported image contains a functional sticker.
contracts.implementationGap: Story image generation exists; interaction-aware contracts and placement-preview acceptance need explicit coverage.
contracts.reviewDecision: Confirm whether interactive Story setup is an operator handoff or a later publishing integration.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Meta & LinkedIn carousels
contracts.treatment: Plan a hook, purposeful progression and close. Each slide adds a new fact or narrative step; retain consistent design and SKU while varying composition to support the story.
inputs: Channel, purpose, ordered messages, slide count and image/document publishing mode.
Evidence for feature/comparison claims, audience and action.
outputs: Two complete ordered sequences of N slides. Proposed default N=5, configurable before generation.
Meta image sequence + caption; LinkedIn document-post PDF where chosen, with selectable text where authored natively, plus post copy.
acceptanceChecks: Every slide and whole sequence pass; hook/close work and no repeated filler slides.
No mixing A/B slides without a new sequence check; LinkedIn PDF exports inspected page by page.
contracts.implementationGap: Sequence planning exists. Complete-set gating and native LinkedIn document export require explicit end-to-end proof.
contracts.reviewDecision: Approve five slides as a proposal; confirm LinkedIn document-post delivery versus paid carousel assets.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Performance Max static asset group
contracts.treatment: Provide clear modular imagery that works with separately supplied ad text. Avoid embedding every headline/CTA into an image intended to be combined dynamically.
inputs: Campaign and asset-group context, final URLs, native text and brand asset requirements.
Merchant Center context and brand-guidelines setting; requested ratio coverage.
outputs: Proposed: two options each at 1200×628 landscape, 1200×1200 square and 960×1200 portrait: six images total.
Native copy/brand fields and image mapping; complete static handoff, not a fully published or video-complete PMax campaign.
acceptanceChecks: Pin current Google field counts/limits and image profile; portrait is client-required here even though optional in the cited platform contract.
Check all required text/brand slots and previews; no cropped identity or duplicated text.
contracts.implementationGap: Native packaging primitives exist; creation/catalogue routes and full group acceptance remain incomplete.
contracts.reviewDecision: Approve six-image default and decide who supplies final URLs, account settings and native ad copy.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Creator, testimonial, meme & BTS stills
contracts.treatment: Use a credible, placement-appropriate human voice and supplied authentic material. A synthetic lifestyle illustration must never masquerade as an actual customer endorsement or real event.
inputs: Rights-cleared creator/BTS/customer material, permissions and exact approved testimony where used.
Trend reference, audience and brand boundaries; truthful source labels.
outputs: Two static treatments per chosen use case; captions, attribution and source/permission references.
UGC-derived stills preserve authentic supplied evidence; conceptual illustrations labelled as such.
acceptanceChecks: No invented testimonial, endorsement, identity or event presented as real.
Editing preserves meaning and relevant disclosures; privacy and permissions checked.
contracts.implementationGap: General generation is available; authenticity/provenance workflow and dedicated creator routes remain to be specified and built.
contracts.reviewDecision: Choose allowed source types; default to supplied authentic material for testimonials and demos.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: LinkedIn single-image posts
contracts.treatment: Give a professional audience a concrete insight, product fact or credible corporate message. Use post text for context; the image carries a concise idea with a readable headline and evidence-led visual.
inputs: Organic or paid placement; square/portrait choice, audience and post objective.
Verified corporate/product/employer facts and image permissions.
outputs: Two options per selected client profile: 1080×1080 square or 1080×1350 portrait; landscape remains a separately pinned existing profile.
Post copy or native ad fields, alt text, source links and image files.
acceptanceChecks: Actual viewing-size readability including CTA and supporting copy; exact product branding and logo margins checked.
Copy-fit recovery cannot lengthen embedded copy; preserved qualifiers still fit.
contracts.implementationGap: Square/portrait runtime routing and copy-fit guards exist. Passing fresh renders and complete options after the final guards are still required.
contracts.reviewDecision: Approve default square + portrait and a concise on-image copy policy; distinguish organic posts from paid ads.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: YouTube Community images & polls
contracts.treatment: Invite a lightweight response from subscribers. Plan a feed-safe image and a conversational post; this is a Community post, not a video thumbnail.
inputs: Image post versus poll, approved prompt/options and chosen square/portrait variants.
Source artwork and link to any real teaser content.
outputs: Two image options per selected ratio plus post text; poll questions/options supplied separately.
Square is the proposed default. Portrait remains in client scope with explicit feed-crop preview.
acceptanceChecks: YouTube recommends 1:1 for feed display; inspect portrait’s collapsed and expanded views.
Poll and image-post modes validated separately; no unavailable video implied by a teaser.
contracts.implementationGap: Community-specific discovery, native fields and preview checks are not established as a completed route.
contracts.reviewDecision: Approve square default; keep portrait optional and require a real Community preview.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Heroes, banners, category tiles & collection cards
contracts.treatment: Fit the actual site component: preserve space for live headline/CTA, useful product scale and focal-point crops. Mobile gets a deliberate composition rather than a squeezed desktop banner.
inputs: Host component/template, container widths, breakpoints, crop behavior and maximum bytes.
Which copy is live HTML versus embedded; linked SKU/category and destination.
outputs: Two coordinated options across each selected desktop/mobile component.
Optimised images, source master, alt text, focal point, live copy/CTA fields and responsive preview plus component manifest.
Client-scope illustrative profiles include ~1920×700 desktop and ~1080×1350 mobile; actual host specifications override. Existing 1920×640 is a separate profile.
acceptanceChecks: Exact host breakpoints and crops inspected; no logo/product/text clipped.
File bytes, dimensions, loading behavior and live text contrast checked in the real component; alt text not a keyword dump.
contracts.implementationGap: Desktop/mobile runtime profiles exist; actual site component integration and responsive delivery acceptance remain open.
contracts.reviewDecision: Supply the first real component specifications. Do not merge 1920×600, 1920×640 and ~1920×700 into one unnamed “banner”.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Landing-page modules & content
contracts.treatment: Build a connected argument from headline to benefit, proof, FAQ and action. Use semantic live text and modular imagery; avoid exporting the whole page as one large picture.
inputs: Page goal, component library, content order, proof and FAQ sources, links and responsive breakpoints.
CMS field schema or agreed HTML handoff and accessibility requirements.
outputs: Two page directions, then one selected complete responsive page/module package is the proposed default.
Hero/benefit/RTB images, native text/FAQ/CTA data, semantic HTML preview and CMS mapping.
acceptanceChecks: All required modules, headings, links and FAQs present; responsive layout, keyboard access and image-off text checked.
No invented FAQ answers; HTML preview does not establish production CMS deployment.
contracts.implementationGap: Module images alone exist as building blocks; page composition, semantic export and host integration are missing delivery work.
contracts.reviewDecision: Choose HTML + structured CMS content as initial delivery, or name the CMS integration required for release.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Google Business Profile store posts
contracts.treatment: Prioritise the local reason to act: store, event or offer. Keep the visual clear; address/date/action belong in native fields and must resolve to the correct outlet.
inputs: Store identity/location, post type, valid offer/event dates, timezone and action URL.
Store data table for bulk variants and selected current GBP profile.
outputs: Two image options per selected post; native post/event/offer/CTA fields and store mapping.
Bulk jobs return one explicit status per store; no publishing by default.
acceptanceChecks: Store, address, dates and URLs match the same record; promotion terms retained.
Validate native required fields and target preview; failures cannot silently omit stores.
contracts.implementationGap: Local image recipes exist; bulk store mappings, native profile validation and complete delivery need implementation.
contracts.reviewDecision: Confirm update/event/offer modes and approved store data source; keep publishing out of initial handoff.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Window, standee, wobbler, product card, wall & price artwork
contracts.treatment: Choose hierarchy and image scale for installed viewing distance, physical fixture and substrate. Long-range signage needs fewer words; a handheld product card can carry more detail.
inputs: Exact fixture/template, physical dimensions, safe zones, bleed/finishing and vendor requirements.
Vendor colour/output profile, actual reading distance, price/offer data, language and editable-source requirement.
outputs: Two concepts per selected physical face, then production export of the selected concept is the proposed default.
PDF with correct physical boxes, RGB master and vendor-specific colour export where supported; calibrated proof tiles and preflight report.
Editable text/layout source if contracted; raster PDF is explicitly not a vector master or certified PDF/X.
acceptanceChecks: Template clearances, dimensions, source PPI at final scale, small text and price terms checked.
Actual operator stock/colour/size proof bound to final file hash; no “press-approved” from digital preview alone.
contracts.implementationGap: Vendor handoff and ICC raster conversion exist; editable production source, dielines/PDF-X where requested and actual physical acceptance remain gaps.
contracts.reviewDecision: Confirm editable format and first vendor templates. No universal bleed, PPI or CMYK profile will be assumed.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Retail screen stills
contracts.treatment: Communicate a product, offer or campaign at store viewing distance. Use sparse copy, large readable elements and screen-specific orientation; no print marks or tiny legal text.
inputs: Screen resolution/orientation, screen-player format, viewing distance and dwell time.
Store/offer details and proof for any price or promotion.
outputs: Two still options per selected screen profile, with filenames, schedule/expiry metadata and player handoff.
acceptanceChecks: Check on the target display/player; offer terms readable at actual distance and no overscan clipping.
No motion/video deliverable implied by a still.
contracts.implementationGap: Static generation exists; display/player profiles and installed viewing acceptance are not established.
contracts.reviewDecision: Choose first landscape and portrait screen profiles and the store display owner for proof.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Partner announcements & co-branded toolkits
contracts.treatment: Balance both identities according to the supplied partnership rules while keeping a single message. Freeze lockup rules before expanding to the toolkit.
inputs: Named primary brand, partner logo/guidelines and authorized partnership facts.
Approved lockup hierarchy, channel/size list and both approval owners.
outputs: Two key-visual options; one selected toolkit adapted across the agreed formats with captions and editable copy.
Approval record references and exact logo/source versions included.
acceptanceChecks: Partner relationship and claims true; lockup clearspace, colour and prominence follow supplied rules.
Cross-brand evidence is used only for this explicitly commissioned co-branding, never injected into the other workspace.
contracts.implementationGap: Co-brand scope is listed; dedicated partner-source/approval contract and toolkit delivery need implementation.
contracts.reviewDecision: Confirm partner approval flow and toolkit sizes; do not treat one internal brand approval as partner acceptance.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Offer, price, EMI & promotion communication
contracts.treatment: Lead with an accurate commercial proposition and preserve readable conditions. Adapt hierarchy to channel and physical context rather than putting a price sticker on every artwork.
inputs: Verified price/MRP/discount/EMI data, eligibility, validity, timezone and exclusions.
Partner lockup rules where applicable; selected target placement contracts.
outputs: Two treatments per selected placement, plus structured offer/terms fields and expiry metadata.
Price changes produce new versions; affected adaptations listed explicitly.
acceptanceChecks: Arithmetic, currency, dates, terms and source SKUs agree; no invented savings or financing claims.
All mandatory qualifiers remain readable at delivery size.
contracts.implementationGap: Generic offer recipe exists; authoritative data validation, expiry handling and dependent-version propagation remain explicit work.
contracts.reviewDecision: Choose authoritative price/offer owner and whether expired assets should be blocked from new export.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: Responsive email & email images
contracts.treatment: Build a readable live-text message with an image that supports it. Subject/preheader/body/action form a coherent sequence; essential information survives images being blocked.
inputs: ESP/template, audience/segment, subject objectives and verified product/offer facts.
Sender, footer, unsubscribe handling, links/tracking and token fallback schema; client test list.
outputs: Two subject/preheader variants and two visual concepts; one selected complete email package per segment is proposed.
Responsive HTML, plain text, hero/module images, live copy, token map and link report.
Send-ready version uses verified HTTPS asset references under an agreed upload workflow; local preview is separate.
acceptanceChecks: Render in agreed clients and mobile widths; image-off, dark mode, links, alt text and unsubscribe behavior checked.
No unresolved tokens; safe fallbacks and segment accuracy; copy/spam checks are advisory, not inbox-placement guarantees.
contracts.implementationGap: HTML/plain-text packaging exists. Creation-route integration, verified hosted assets and target-client proof remain incomplete.
contracts.reviewDecision: Confirm ESP, client test list and initial token set. Approve one final email after two concepts, not two fully built emails by default.
contracts.status: Proposed — not approved or a runtime configuration

contracts.title: WhatsApp card & Status
contracts.treatment: Make a concise conversational visual and keep the action/longer detail in the native message. Status is vertical; a chat card uses its own selected image profile.
inputs: Chat versus Status, organic share versus business-template send, provider profile.
Approved template/category if needed, message, links, tokens and exact source facts.
outputs: Two complete image options per selected mode plus message/body/action fields and token mapping.
